items.title: Meta Ads: $146.39 spend, 11 leads, $13.31 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: The most recent prior meta-ads.json (2026-09-02) covered spend through 2026-09-01, so this run widened from the standard --days 1 to --days 3 (2026-09-02 through 2026-09-04) to close the gap. Over that window Meta spent $146.39, all on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 11 leads at $13.31 CPL. CPL is well below the 7-day baseline (2026-08-29 to 2026-09-04: $351.87 / 21 leads, ~$16.76 CPL); account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Window widened: the most recent prior meta-ads.json was 2026-09-02, covering spend through 2026-09-01. Per policy this run widened from the standard yesterday-only pull to 3 days (2026-09-02 through 2026-09-04) to cover the gap, rather than missing 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-03 entirely.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 11 in this window, 21 in the 7-day baseline, matching the counted leads exactly both times, same as flagged on 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-02). No discrepancy in the counted total so far, but this recurrence (now a third time) suggests the script's lead-action set should be reviewed for extension rather than continuing to hand-note it each run.
